interface.title: FuzzyMind (FCM app): FCM Designer, FCM Designer Linguistic, FCM Learning
interface.field: Fuzzy cognitive mapping / causal systems modelling (decision support, socio-environmental and health systems)
interface.stage_of_work: Building a model and running what-if simulations; learning model weights from data
interface.what_it_is_for: Build, upload or aggregate fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs), view them as weighted directed graphs, run iterative inference from a starting state until it settles, and learn FCM weights from tabular data with a Neural-FCM.

data.note: I built a 3-concept numeric map by hand. I uploaded fcm_example_bacteria_city.csv, a 7-concept weight matrix (Num_people, Migration, Modernization, Garbage, Sanitation, Num_diseases, Bacteria). I uploaded aggregation1-4.csv and aggregation1-4.json as four experts' files. I uploaded learning_dataset.csv: 15 rows and 7 columns, with one blank in C1 Num_people (row 6). The app is slow: each rerun takes several seconds, and the first page load took about a minute.

tree.general: Model a system as weighted cause-and-effect links between concepts, simulate how it evolves from a starting state, and learn the link weights from measured data
tree.specific: Construct, load or combine fuzzy cognitive maps, draw them as graphs, run FCM inference until equilibrium, and import a dataset for Neural-FCM weight learning

screens_never_reached: Aggregated / defuzzified weight matrix and its graph: 'Aggregation info...' raised AttributeError 'DataFrame' object has no attribute 'applymap' (design_manually_linguistic.py line 529). This is an installation problem, not an app limitation: the installed pandas no longer has DataFrame.applymap (deprecated in 2.1, removed in 3.0), so nothing after it rendered (screens/068.webp)
FCM Designer Linguistic File Upload mode and its Inference tab: I opened neither within the action budget

Learning page: Data Visualization tab, Data Transformation, Data Normalization and Data Split subtabs, and the Learning tab (Neural-FCM classifier/regressor training): I ran out of actions after opening Data Cleansing
Home page: it stayed blank while the app was starting (screens/001.webp) and I did not go back to it
not_done: I could not aggregate multiple experts' linguistic maps into one defuzzified matrix. Right after the CSV/JSON pairs were confirmed to match, opening 'Aggregation info...' crashed with AttributeError: 'DataFrame' object has no attribute 'applymap'. The cause is the pandas version in this environment, so pinning an older pandas should fix it.

On replay, turning 'Contains index' ON with fcm_example_bacteria_city.csv crashed with ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'C1 Num_people' (file_upload.py line 41). The file loads correctly with the toggle OFF, which is the setting the run used.
I did not apply imputation or outlier removal to the blank cell and the out-of-range 15.00 value. The Imputation panel was open with its column and method dropdowns, but I did not choose any.
I did not transform, normalize or split the dataset into input/output concepts, and did not train the Neural-FCM classifier or regressor. I stopped at the action limit (about 100 actions).
I did not build a linguistic map by hand (concepts plus linguistic terms in the matrix) and did not defuzzify it.
I did not try the 'Download figure', 'Download as CSV' or 'Edit weight matrix values' controls, and did not try the Bivalent/Trivalent functions or the plain Kosko rule.
I did not rename concepts on the hand-built map. A Ctrl+A in the concept grid selected the cells instead of editing them, so the default Concept_1-3 names stayed.

Usability notes: grid cells only opened for editing on the second double-click, and typing reliably needed the editor's own text box. Changing the activation function or rule cleared the initial state vector and the old results.
